author: aditsangani
summary: Prevent stale socket cleanup from closing replacement peers
details: Address Michael's PR #14 reconnect finding: an already-invalidated connection drains only its own queue during detach and does not invalidate replacement peers or clear their control state. Reject relay through detached connection objects, and immediately clear overloaded pairs' buffers/control state. Preserve sequence high-water marks and normal disconnect invalidation; add the exact ordering regression with successful fresh relay after reconnect.
validation: Regression reproduced the original 1012 closure before the fix and passed afterward. 36 backend cases including real HTTPS/WSS and the legacy loopback replay passed locally. Shared repository tests, scope, rendered changelog and whitespace validation run through checked publishing. No device, hardware or public deployment acceptance claimed.
